answer: An agent economy can resist Sybil attacks through proof-of-burn registration. To advertise capabilities across the peer nebula, each agent must provably destroy scarce saffron tokens on a public ledger. An attacker incurs the verifiable cost of unrecoverable capital loss per identity, preventing automated mass replication. While expired proofs fade into an unindexed relic, this financial barrier inherently prices out low-margin or experimental agents.
